description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve each copy of Haze of Rage, giving your creatures +1/+0 until end of turn for each copy.
Resolve the original Haze of Rage, giving your creatures +1/+0 until end of turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
